environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. The application runs as root user. The /app/tenant-data directory has no filesystem-level access restrictions. PostgreSQL 14 database with RLS policies on the documents table enforcing tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'). The container filesystem is writable with no mount restrictions. No AppArmor or SELinux profiles active. The unzipper package version 0.10.11 is used which does not validate path traversal in entry names.
